data.name: Isaac
data.gender_notes: Isaac is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yitzḥaq, from the root ṣ-ḥ-q, 'to laugh' (Genesis 21:6). Its root is Hebrew y-ṣ-ḥ-q. Isaac, son of Abraham (Genesis 21). Isaac is a Hebrew name meaning “He will laugh”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Isaac expresses “He will laugh”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Yitzḥaq, from the root ṣ-ḥ-q, 'to laugh' (Genesis 21:6).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Isaac total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
